notes: Two routes that each write their own names, so two groups, no shared tail
«قال وسمعت سفيان الثوري يحدث بهذا الحديث» then the saying again: whether this is a third route of the same saying or a remark is not settled, so it is not written as a route
«في حديثه» and «أخبرني» are verbs or remarks, not names
